outcome: admission rates to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 204 pregnant women with thrombophilia and previous poor obstetric outcomes
finding: Anticoagulant therapy, particularly with both LMWH and ASA, was associated with improved obstetric outcomes, including higher live birth rate, gestational age at birth, and Apgar scores, compared to no anticoagulant therapy.
